name: Necromancy Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Inflict Wounds; Ray of Enfeeblement; Vampiric Touch; Blight; Raise Dead. Reference-only: After a slotted Necromancy, roll and spend up to two unused Hit Dice to heal their total plus slot level.
